summary: Iteration 20 — Portfolio Map Filters (land/property/country/currency). Backend 7/7 pytest tests pass covering GET /api/portfolio/map `country` field: present on every pin, derived from Nominatim addressdetails and cached on the project (second call fast, no re-geocode), null when address missing, manual-pin projects keep their lat/lon but still get `country` learned from the geocoded address, multi-currency/multi-type/multi-country mix returned. Note: Nominatim localises Spain as 'España' (not 'Spain') — the UI chip renders accordingly. Frontend UI verified end-to-end on 390x844 viewport: demo login → projects → portfolio-map-screen loads with map-filters bar containing map-filter-type-all/-residential/-land, map-filter-currency-GBP/-EUR, map-filter-country-all + per-country chips (map-filter-country-united-kingdom, map-filter-country-españa). Created a EUR land project at 'Calle Mayor 1, Madrid, Spain' alongside the existing GBP UK residential; verified: Land filter → 1 row (Madrid), EUR filter → 1 row (Madrid, pin-count '1/1 on map · 2 total'), EUR+España combo → 1 row, España alone → 1 row, España+GBP → 0 rows with map-filter-empty + map-clear-filters visible, Clear filters resets to 2/2 on map, United Kingdom chip → 1 row (Nottingham). Map pins update to match filter. Each row shows country·currency subline. Cleanup: TEST_iter20_Madrid Plot deleted, Nottingham Victorian Refurb re-activated.

minor.issue: Country name is returned in Nominatim's localised form (e.g. 'España' instead of 'Spain', 'Deutschland' instead of 'Germany'). This causes inconsistent user-facing labels and testID slugs. Consider passing `accept-language=en` to Nominatim so UI shows canonical English names. Reference: /app/backend/routes/fx.py:75.

issues: Country chip label follows the Nominatim locale (shows 'España' rather than 'Spain'); the testID slug becomes 'map-filter-country-españa' which contains a non-ASCII character — functional but fragile for automation. Consider normalising country names (en locale) or using an ASCII-safe slug (unidecode).

action_items: (Minor) Pass `accept-language=en` to Nominatim in routes/fx.py:portfolio_map so country names come back canonical (Spain, Germany, ...) rather than localised (España, Deutschland). This also stabilises the UI slug 'map-filter-country-<slug>' to ASCII.

(Pre-existing, unrelated) POST /api/documents still fails with 500 because EMERGENT_LLM_KEY lacks objstore scope (401 at integrations.emergentagent.com/objstore/api/v1/storage/init). Reported in iter 19 — not caused by iter 20.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/fx.py:portfolio_map correctly caches country on the project (persists via geocoded_for + country) and respects Nominatim's 1 req/s + 10/call cap — great.

routes/fx.py:67 uses `d.get('geocoded_for') != d['address'] or 'country' not in d` to decide re-geocoding — this is backward-compatible for pre-existing projects that have geocoded_for but no country.
portfolio-map.tsx uses `(p.country ?? 'Unknown')` for grouping — matches spec. The filter predicate is pure/memoised and recomputes correctly on chip changes.
portfolio-map.tsx `map-pin-count` text appends ' · N total' only when `filtered` is true (type!=='all' || country || cur) — matches spec exactly.

map-filter-country-{slug} uses `c.replace(/\s+/g, '-').toLowerCase()`. For non-ASCII country names (España) the slug keeps the ñ; consider adding `.normalize('NFKD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g,'')` for ASCII-safe slugs if backend starts returning localised names.
Chip from ui components has adequate touch targets (confirmed via screenshot — chips are well-sized on 390x844).
